description: Connect a local .brand/ to Brandcode Studio. Two modes: "pull" (default) downloads an existing hosted brand by URL/slug. "save" uploads the local .brand/ to Studio (requires prior auth via brand_brandcode_auth). THE tool when the user says "make our brand available to my whole team", "share our brand with the team", "connect to Brandcode", "pull from Studio", "save brand to Studio", or "upload my brand". Returns brand name, slug, sync token, and connection details.

mode.description: "pull" connects to an existing hosted brand and downloads it. "save" uploads the local .brand/ to Studio (requires auth via brand_brandcode_auth).

url.description: Brandcode Studio brand URL or slug. Required for mode="pull". Examples: "https://brandcode.studio/start/brands/pendium", "pendium"

name: brand_brandcode_connect
title: Connect to Brandcode Studio
